items.q: Mary Baker Eddy, Science and Health. Because she made one statement that says, 'Discord is not music.'

ctx.x: Mary Baker Eddy, Science and Health. Because she made one statement that says, 'Discord is not music.' And we know that. Because when a cat gets up and plays a wrong note... That's one Jelly Roll Morton had to say. 'if you get lost, lay out.' Because he didn't want you to make no bad notes. And that was an easy thing to do, because if you got lost, just keep horn in your mouth and keeping playing like you're playing, and when you find the right place to...the right number to come in, you come in. But he said it…
So in conclusion, that's what you want to say, Foots?
